name: Ohio Pumpkin LLC
tagline: West of Cleveland: Erie, Huron and Lorain counties Pumpkin U
description: In 10558 N Elyria Road, OH, Ohio Pumpkin LLC grows Strawberries, Blackberries, Apples, Peaches, and Nectarines on an independent pumpkin patch. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
